summary: A String is text in double quotes. Use length() to count characters, charAt() to get one, and equals() to compare two Strings.
notes: length() is a method, so it needs parentheses. Arrays use length with no parentheses.
charAt(0) returns the first character as a char.
equals() compares the text. == compares whether two variables point to the same object.
pitfall: Comparing Strings with == can print false even when the text matches, as search == artist shows. Use equals().
